name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 4 - Scratch Decomposition
description: Practice words for decomposition and subroutines.

words.definition: Breaking a big task into smaller parts.
words.example: Students used decomposition during the project.

words.definition: A smaller named part of a program that can be reused.
words.example: Students used subroutine during the project.

words.definition: To run a subroutine from another part of a program.
words.example: Students used call during the project.

words.definition: The main set of instructions that controls a project.
words.example: Students used main program during the project.

words.definition: To use something again instead of rebuilding it.
